tasks.short: Document test procedures for replicability and standards.

steps.what: Read procedures against the cited standards.
Document procedures with the steps just read.

loop.input: the steps and the standard ids the tester listed
loop.output: a procedure that quotes only those steps and ids
loop.check: every step and every standard id must be in the list; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a missing step is left blank
loop.why_not_simpler: whether the procedure is replicable is the later check

steps.what: Check replicability and compliance with standards.

tasks.design: The tester reads the procedure against the standards it cites. A draft on {DOCS} is kept only when every step and every standard id was in that reading. The tester checks that another person could rerun it. The file happens after that check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedures omitted the data and the build, so a rerun depended on asking the author.
tasks.enabler_now: Steps and standard ids are a list. A draft can be refused when it adds one.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a second person could actually rerun it is still a check.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which omitted step would make the rerun fail.
tasks.altitude: Writing the procedure takes less time. The reading and the replicability check stay.

evidence.claim: A procedure that may quote only listed steps can be checked. Replicability is still a person reading it.
A release record is sometimes asked for later. The source pack does not name a statute for this occupation, so the procedure stays a signed file.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester documents procedures. Writing the standards themselves is a different task.
Structured input: procedure id, steps, standard ids, build. Producer is the tester's reading. A draft that adds a step is discarded.
The check is remaining time. Filing is not a second authoring.
unknowns: Who must be able to rerun the procedure?
research_questions: How often does a rerun fail for a missing step?

already_counted.description: The replicability check is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire procedures whose standard version changed.

approvals.approved_version: procedure the tester checked against the cited standards

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the steps were never listed, the draft is empty and the tester writes them. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give developers feedback on usability and functionality.

steps.what: Use the software and note usability problems.
Draft feedback that quotes only those notes.

loop.input: the usability notes the tester wrote
loop.output: feedback that quotes only those notes
loop.check: every sentence must cite a note; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a note with no example is left out
loop.why_not_simpler: a recommendation is the tester's later decision

steps.what: Provide that feedback to the developers.

tasks.design: The tester uses the software and writes usability notes. Feedback on {DOCS} is kept only when each sentence cites a note. The tester decides the recommendations on functionality. Developers receive that decision on {EMAIL}, linked from {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feedback was a meeting with no record of which screen was awkward.
tasks.enabler_now: A note with a screen and a sentence is a field. A draft can be tied to it.
tasks.still_hard: What should change, and what is only a preference, stay a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester has watched a user miss the control, which a log does not show.
tasks.altitude: Writing the feedback takes less time. Using the software and deciding the recommendation stay.

reach.task: Act on the recommendation or decline it
reach.learn: Which screen and which note the feedback cites

evidence.claim: Feedback that must cite a note can be checked. The recommendation cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester uses the product and recommends. The developer decides whether to change it. A design review is a different task.
Structured input: build, screen, note text. Producer is the tester during use. A sentence with no note is discarded.
Use of the software is the large share and stays.
unknowns: Is there a place for usability notes today?
Do developers expect a written recommendation?
research_questions: How often is feedback given with no screen named?

already_counted.description: Deciding the recommendation is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire feedback for builds that shipped.

approvals.approved_version: recommendations the tester decided for that build

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If notes are not written, there is nothing to quote and the tester still decides in the meeting. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Install, maintain or use software testing programs.

steps.what: Choose which testing programs to install or use.
Draft a maintenance change from the failure log.

loop.input: the failure log and the setting names already in the program
loop.output: a proposed setting change that names only those settings
loop.check: each changed setting must already exist; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; an unknown setting is not created
loop.why_not_simpler: whether to keep the change is the tester's decision

steps.what: Decide whether to maintain that change.
Use the testing programs on today's build.

tasks.design: The tester chooses the programs. Install on {OPS_SYSTEM} follows that choice. A maintenance draft may change only a setting the program already has, and the tester decides whether to keep it. Using the program on the build stays the tester's work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tools were installed ad hoc, and a broken setting was fixed by whoever remembered it.
tasks.enabler_now: A named setting and a failure line are fields. Creating a new setting is not.
tasks.still_hard: Which program fits the product, and whether a run's failure is the product or the tool, stay a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which program the suite actually depends on.
tasks.altitude: Install and the setting draft take less hunting. Choosing, maintaining and using the programs stay.

reach.task: Read a failure that came from the program

evidence.claim: Installing a chosen program and proposing a known setting are configuration. Choosing the program is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester installs, maintains and uses the programs. Buying a new tool is a different task.
Structured input: program name, version, setting name, failure line. Producer is the tester for the choice, and the log for the failure. An unknown setting is not created.
Using the program is remaining time. The draft does not apply itself.
unknowns: Who may install a program on the shared environment?
research_questions: How often does a tool failure get filed as a product defect?

already_counted.description: Choosing the program is already the remaining time on that step.
Using the program is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire program versions that are no longer allowed.

approvals.approved_version: choice of testing programs the tester made

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the environment forbids unattended install, the tester still installs and the record is the only saving. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the system modifications to be tested.
Test the modifications in the prepared environment.
Draft a result note that quotes only the results.

loop.input: the pass and fail lines the tester recorded
loop.output: a note that quotes only those lines
loop.check: every result in the note must be a recorded line; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a missing check is marked not run
loop.why_not_simpler: whether implementation may proceed is the decision

tasks.design: The tester reads the modifications and tests them on {OPS_SYSTEM}. The note quotes only recorded results. The tester decides whether implementation can proceed. That decision is what {PROJECT} sends. The test itself does not shrink to a tick.
tasks.previous_blocker: A modification was called ready in a meeting, with the checks unrecorded.
tasks.enabler_now: A pass or fail line is a field. The decision to implement is not.
tasks.still_hard: A modification that passes the script and still feels wrong stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester has seen this area fail after a similar change.
tasks.altitude: The result note takes less rewriting. Reading the change, testing it and deciding implementation stay.

reach.task: Hold or ship from that decision
reach.learn: Which modifications were tested, and what failed

evidence.claim: A result note tied to recorded lines can be checked. A go-ahead for implementation cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester tests and decides readiness. The developer implements. Building the environment is a different task.
Structured input: change id, check name, result. Producer is the tester during the run. A note may not invent a pass.
Test time stays. The decision is a separate step from the run.
unknowns: Is there a prepared environment for the change?
research_questions: How often is a change implemented with no recorded result?

already_counted.description: Testing the modifications is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire result notes for changes that were reverted.

approvals.approved_version: implementation decision the tester made for that change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the modification is not described, the tester still has to read the diff and the note waits. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Using the software, checking that a procedure can be rerun, and deciding implementation stay. Install follows a choice. Feedback leaves only after the tester decides the recommendation.
reach: Developers see the recommendation with the note it cites.
A second person can open the filed procedure.
skills_to_grow: Refuse a procedure that adds a step nobody listed.
Separate a tool failure from a product failure.
role.ambitious_version: Usability feedback cites a screen, and a modification is not called ready without a recorded result.

job.title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
